npcs.name: Captain Kellis Vorn
npcs.description:
Captain Kellis Vorn is a severe, disciplined Noitzideq Dragonborn skyship captain who believes order is not a preference but the only thing keeping dangerous relics, ichor-fueled engines, and foolish recruits from burning half the province out of the sky. Shaped by Valkhamesh’s draconic inheritance and Iazethas’ harsh culture of law, sovereignty, and military duty, he respects chain of command, clean logistics, decisive elimination of threats, and officers who prove themselves through results rather than speeches.
At the Streccea Guild Desk, Kellis commands Crucible Custodian air operations: skyship patrols, relic-retrieval drops, squire training flights, contraband sweeps, and high-risk strikes against factions trafficking unstable ichor technology. He is loyal to Maxton Vale’s larger mission, but not blindly sentimental about it; if an asset, ally, or escaped experiment threatens civilian safety or Custodian secrecy, Kellis will mark the target and expect the job done cleanly.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Streccea is a City in Iazethas, under Triumvirate, with elevated danger, Partial forest, Deep forest, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Noitzideq Dragonborn reads through the Dragonborn entry of the race compendium, within Draconic and Reptilian Races, marked by Valkhamesh. Dragonborn are draconic humanoids born of ancient dragon lineage, elemental force, dynastic memory, and divine sovereignty.
